commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; cat /etc/redhat-release
printf 'platform_group='; getent group platform || true
printf 'workspace='; stat -c 'path=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a type=%F' /srv/platform 2>/dev/null || echo absent
printf 'setfacl='; command -v setfacl || true
commands.error: The Antrieb managed cluster lease expired
The Antrieb managed cluster lease expired
